description: Shaking plate (Stage C2), XPBD: the 10 cm block starts 2 mm above a 25 x 1 x 25 cm plate, settles, and from t = 1 s the plate shakes along x (amplitude ramps up over 0.5 s). Material as drop_xpbd_volume.json (edge compliance 1/300 m/N, volume compliance 1e-6 1/Pa) at 100 substeps: at 50, XPBD is effectively softer and over-responds to the shake (Stage C2).
